description: This file defines a PHP class 'PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams' which extends the 'FilterParams' class and provides search filter parameters specifically for reports in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes properties for report name and report ID, along with their getter and setter methods, and sets a default sort field upon instantiation.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for defining search filter parameters for reports within the PIM module. Includes properties for 'name' and 'reportId' with default sorting by 'report.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'report.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the report name filter value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the report name filter value.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID filter value.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID filter value.
